subject: Objective Charter: Quarter Sprint Readout & Owner Commitments
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Objective Charter: Quarter Sprint Readout & Owner Commitments

Team —

Attached is the draft objective charter for the coming quarter (Q4). I pulled together a short owner map and success metrics so we can get aligned quickly: please review and call out any blockers. Goal is to finalize by EOD Friday so we can include the charter in the kickoff readout.

High-level objectives (short):
- Objective A: Improve hosted API p99 latency across common models — owner: Karthik — target p99 < 180ms for 90% of requests
- Objective B: Reduce per-token cost for standard gen workload via batching/quantization — owner: Grace — target 18% unit cost reduction
- Objective C: Launch Private deployment pilot with FinMachinery — owner: Vivek — onboarding + pilot success metrics listed in sheet
- Objective D: Improve observability for model regressions (quality alerts) — owner: Laura — define 3 evals and alert thresholds
- Objective E: Grow partner integrations (marketplace and docs) — owner: Ben — 2 marketplace listings planned

Asks:
1) Review the attached charter and add line edits inline (file: Q4_Objective_Charter_v1.xlsx).
2) If you own an objective, confirm owners and adjust targets by Thursday COB.
3) Anyone with dependencies on FinMachinery pilot, flag risk matrix in the sheet (tab: PilotRisk).

Attachment: Q4_Objective_Charter_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — I want a tight 15-minute leadership readout next Tuesday, so if we can lock owners now that helps planning.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Product Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Objective Charter: Quarter Sprint Readout & Owner Commitments

Ben — good start, thanks. Quick notes inline and a couple of higher-level asks: see attached with highlights.

Top comments:
- Objective B: tightening the unit-cost target to a percent is fine, but add a baseline (current unit cost) and the exact batching profile to make QA measurable.
- Objective C (FinMachinery pilot): add an explicit SLA/uptime target for the pilot environment and a rollback trigger; we should not conflate pilot scope with general GA requirements.
- Objective D: call out the specific eval prompt sets (prod-sample-1, prod-sample-2) and the cadence (weekly).

I moved owner for Objective A from Karthik to Karthik + infra lead (we should pair), and I attached my annotated spreadsheet: LAURA_comments_Q4_Objective_Charter_v1.xlsx

Attachment: LAURA_comments_Q4_Objective_Charter_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

I'll try to join the readout — please make sure the deck includes a one-slide risk summary per objective.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Objective Charter: Quarter Sprint Readout & Owner Commitments

Ben — I support the high-level split. A couple of asks from the infra/ops side: 
- For Objective C (FinMachinery), we need a short onboarding checklist for pilot customers and an agreed SLO for the private endpoint. Can the charter include a single-row acceptance criteria table?
- Grace: can you confirm CS resource allocation for pilot support for the first 6 weeks?

If those two items are in the final, I'm OK signing off. Also: can we produce a 3-slide executive readout (summary, risks, owners) for the Tuesday slot?

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni

Ben/Laura — thanks for including us. Quick response from the FinMachinery side: we can meet the pilot SLOs below if the private endpoint is provisioned with the following constraints.

Pilot SLOs proposed:
- Availability: 99.5% (pilot window)
- Tail latency (95th): < 300ms for standard gen (batch size 8)
- Throughput: support up to 500 concurrent sessions during test window

Onboarding checklist (high level):
- VPN/VPC peering and IP allowlist
- Test dataset and schema mapping (we'll provide sample fixtures)
- Runbook and incident contact list

Attachment: FinMachinery_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF)

We'll review the PilotRisk tab and push a short SOW back by tomorrow. Happy to join the Tuesday readout for the pilot section.

— Rebecca Shaw
Director, Product Ops | Nimbus Analytics (FinMachinery partner)
